description: Search App Store and Google Play apps across 25+ filters — store, category, games and game genres (named alike on both stores), language (including not_languages, a localization-gap filter that finds apps NOT localized in a given language), price model, rating, review count, download and revenue estimates (min and max), release and update recency, and review-growth direction — sorted by any column. The tool behind niche sizing, competitor shortlists, and localization-gap hunting. Cost: 1 credit per row returned (an empty page costs 1).

inputSchema.description: Explore-grade app search. Every filter is optional; supplied ones combine (AND).

categories.description: Several category names to include, e.g. ['Health & Fitness', 'Lifestyle']. Takes precedence over 'category'.
categories.title: Categories

category.description: Store category name to filter by, e.g. 'Health & Fitness', 'Productivity', 'Games'. Use 'categories' to include several at once.
category.title: Category

game_genres.description: Games of these genres, named alike on both stores, e.g. ['Puzzle', 'Role Playing', 'Strategy'] (also Action, Adventure, Arcade, Board, Card, Casino, Casual, Educational, Family, Music, Racing, Simulation, Sports, Trivia, Word). Implies 'games'.
game_genres.title: Game Genres

games.description: true: games only, on both stores — the App Store 'Games' category and every Google Play game category. Narrow with 'game_genres'.
games.title: Games

growth_direction.description: Keep only apps growing ('up') or declining ('down') over 'growth_period'.
growth_direction.title: Growth Direction

growth_metric.description: Metric the growth filter measures — currently only 'reviews'.
growth_metric.title: Growth Metric

growth_period.description: Window growth is measured over: '7d', '14d', '30d', '60d' or '90d', for both stores. Google Play apps are measured every few weeks, so their 14-90 day growth is pro-rated from each app's nearest earlier measurement and covers far more Play apps than '7d' does.
growth_period.title: Growth Period

language.description: Single app-language code the listing supports, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'pt-BR'.
language.title: Language

languages.description: Several app-language codes to include, e.g. ['en', 'es'].
languages.title: Languages

limit.description: How many apps to return, 1-100. If omitted: 20 for assistant sign-in connections, 50 with an API key. Each returned app costs 1 credit, so ask for the page size you need; when the balance is lower, the page shrinks to the balance.
limit.title: Limit

max_days_since_release.description: Only apps first released within this many days, e.g. 90 for fresh launches.
max_days_since_release.title: Max Days Since Release

max_days_since_update.description: Only apps updated within this many days, e.g. 30 for actively maintained apps.
max_days_since_update.title: Max Days Since Update

max_rating.description: Highest average star rating to include, 0-5; use to find weak incumbents.
max_rating.title: Max Rating

max_revenue.description: Highest estimated monthly revenue in USD, e.g. 50000 for $50K/month.
max_revenue.title: Max Revenue

max_reviews.description: Highest lifetime review count, e.g. 1000 to exclude entrenched giants.
max_reviews.title: Max Reviews

min_growth_pct.description: Lowest absolute growth percentage over 'growth_period', e.g. 20 for at least ±20%.
min_growth_pct.title: Min Growth Pct

min_rating.description: Lowest average star rating to include, 0-5, e.g. 4.
min_rating.title: Min Rating

min_revenue.description: Lowest estimated monthly revenue in USD, e.g. 10000 for $10K/month.
min_revenue.title: Min Revenue

not_languages.description: Localization-gap filter: return only apps NOT localized in any of these language codes, e.g. ['it'] finds apps without an Italian localization. App Store data only — combine with languages=['en'] to shortlist English apps missing a target market's language.
not_languages.title: Not Languages

offset.description: How many apps to skip before returning results; use for paging.
offset.title: Offset

price_model.description: Monetisation model: 'Free', 'Freemium' or 'Paid'. Case-insensitive on input.
price_model.title: Price Model

released_after.description: Only apps released on or after this date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
released_after.title: Released After

released_before.description: Only apps released on or before this date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
released_before.title: Released Before

search.description: Free-text query matched against app title and developer name, e.g. 'calorie tracker'.
search.title: Search

search_in.description: Which field 'search' matches: 'title', 'developer', or 'all' (default). Use 'developer' to list a publisher's portfolio.
search_in.title: Search In

store.description: Limit results to one store: 'apple' (App Store) or 'google' (Google Play). Omit to search both.
store.title: Store

updated_after.description: Only apps last updated on or after this date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
updated_after.title: Updated After

updated_before.description: Only apps last updated on or before this date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
updated_before.title: Updated Before

name: search_apps
title: Search apps
